instructions.content: NEVER register a component path with a leading slash; paths in `components: {}` are relative to the project root
NEVER omit `<slot />` when wrapping a built-in component
NEVER access page data via `Astro.props` in override components; use `Astro.locals.starlightRoute`
NEVER rely on file name to determine which slot is overridden; only the key in `components: {}` matters
NEVER forget to transfer named slots on layout components such as `PageFrame` and `TwoColumnContent`
NEVER import component internals not listed in the Overrides Reference
NEVER fully replace a component when wrapping the default would do
NEVER guess the slot name; use the exact name from the Overrides Reference
NEVER override a component when CSS alone is enough; use `starlight-theme`
NEVER use this skill to add documentation pages or sidebars; use `starlight-base`
Identify the slot name from the Overrides Reference or Overrides Map before creating the component
Register the component under its slot key in `components: {}` inside `starlight({})` in `astro.config.mjs`
Use `Astro.locals.starlightRoute.id` to apply an override conditionally on specific pages
